item.title: Volkswagening
item.description: volkswagening (verb): systematically deceive through sophisticated technological means while presenting oneself as virtuous, particularly in matters of environmental responsibility or corporate ethics. Inspired from the qz article: Samsung is accused of Volkswagening its TVs to oversell their energy efficiency
